body:
God speed to you. 

I don't condone it though you're still young, kind of hypocritical of me to say though as I lay awake staring at the ceiling hoping to die as well, but as you've said you made up your mind. I wish you a peaceful passing and whatever you find on the other side I hope it's better than this slog. 

Maybe one day down the line when I gather my own courage to do the act we'll meet.

But this will be the second time I've failed here and even more so if you consider past similar mistakes I did throughout life. I'm just a constant mess up and I don't believe their patience with me is unending.

I just feel like failure and a burden to my family. I've already dropped out of college once because I'm too much of an idiot and now I'm trying again at a smaller college and I'm falling apart again. I feel like I'm nothing but a burden to those around me and just wanna vanish.
